title: Split the scripting is disabled check for event handlers
body: Moving this check to compile time in 1a249c2 restored the arrangement from before 905b721 ([WebDriver BiDi] enable and disable scripting via BiDi) and undid it: with scripting disabled through WebDriver BiDi an event handler IDL attribute returned null again, and an event handler whose value is a function ran. "Scripting is disabled" bundles three conditions that want different treatment, so check them where they belong instead: * A null browsing context and the sandboxed scripts browsing context flag stop an internal raw uncompiled handler from being compiled. This is what implementations do, and it is all they do: an event handler IDL attribute set to a function still runs in a document without a browsing context, and in Chromium and Gecko in one sandboxed without allow-scripts. * WebDriver BiDi scripting being disabled stops the event handler from running, while leaving the IDL attribute returning the function.
